;======================================================
;DO NOT EDIT HERE!
; Initialize (at the start of the round)
[Statedef 5900]
type = S

[State 5900, 1] ;Clear all int variables
type = VarRangeSet
trigger1 = roundsexisted = 0
value = 0
[State 5900, 2] ;Clear all float variables
type = VarRangeSet
trigger1 = roundsexisted = 0
fvalue = 0

[State 5900, 2] ;Clear all float variables
type = VarSet
trigger1 = 1
fv = 7
value = 1


[State 5900, 3] ;Change palette
type = RemapPal
trigger1 = 1
source = 1,1
dest = 1,palno
;======================================================



;START EDITING HERE
[State 5900, Turbo Mode]
type = VarSet
trigger1 = 1 
v = 20
value = 0
;Set to 1 or higher to turn on Turbo Mode
;Set to 0 or lower to turn it off (default)





;======================================================
;STOP EDITING HERE

[State 5900, Auto Turbo Mode]
type = VarSet
trigger1 = name = "Turbo Mr. Game & Watch"
v = 20
value = 1

[State 5900, 4] ;Intro for round 1
type = ChangeState
trigger1 = roundno = 1
value = 190

[State 5900, 5] ;All other rounds
type = ChangeState
trigger1 = 1
value = 0
